main_problems: No incorrect or outdated facts were found. Every checked hour and fee matches the official pages as of 2026-10-11.

8 claims have no primary source: Otaru 9 a.m. status update, Dogo Important Cultural Property status, Dogo private rooms having no bath, Matsuyama and Motobu locations, Kinrinko autumn mist, Osaka pre-2025 prices, Dazaifu Tobiume.
Every record is missing time needed, and most are missing concrete public-transport access. Korean-language support is stated only for Todaiji.
Some records simplify the source and lose useful detail: Otaru North Canal lamp hours, Kumamoto ticket booth closing at 16:00, Dogo private-room courses, Dazaifu museum last entry at 16:00.

The hours_and_fees schema is inconsistent. Some records use hours/fees/conditions and others use a single details field. Sensoji has fees set to null where the guide should say there is no admission fee.
Useful facts that the cited sources already contain were left out: JNTO access times, the Osaka payment methods, and the Dazaifu parking advice.
